title: GTA 6's Expectedly Massive File Size Has Been Revealed
text: GTA 6's Expectedly Massive File Size Has Been Revealed Skip to content Kotaku Latest Entertainment Reviews News Tips & Guides Games Downloads Deals Games GTA 6′ s Expectedly Massive File Size Has Been Revealed Leonida needs its space Grand Theft Auto 6 GTA 6 By Rebekah Valentine Published October 27, 2026 | Comments ( 20 ) | 𝕏 Copied! © Rockstar Games We always knew that GTA 6 would be one hell of a massive download, and thanks to reports today, it sounds like we might know just how much space this thing is going to take up on our PlayStations and/or Xboxes. According to multiple reports, GTA 6 is a whopping 210 GB. This originally came from PlayStation Game Size, a Twitter/X account that, true to its name, posts the file sizes of various PlayStation games. 🚨 Grand Theft Auto VI – 𝐃𝐨𝐰𝐧𝐥𝐨𝐚𝐝 𝐒𝐢𝐳𝐞 : 210 GB – 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐫𝐝 ($79.99) Pre-Load : November 12 Release : November 19 𝐑𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐞 : Midnight pic.twitter.com/5vXkgnqfC7 - PlayStation Game Size (@PlaystationSize) October 27, 2026 It was then corroborated by Insider Gaming not long after, making it likely that this number is accurate. That’s a big file, yup. It’s not the biggest. On console, it’s surpassed by multiple Call of Duties and ARK: Survival Evolved once you get all the DLC involved. As someone who will be playing on an original Xbox Series S, GTA 6 will take up nearly two-thirds of my usable storage space. I’ll probably have to delete just about everything that’s on there—probably just room for this and Elden Ring: Nightreign . This is on consoles, mind. Who knows what that PC file is going to look like! You know, whenever that inevitably happens. That number also doesn’t take into account anything else you might need to install with GTA 6 . Maybe there’s a day-one patch. And while nothing’s been announced, there will almost certainly be various content updates or even DLC added down the line. And it doesn’t include whatever the game’s version of GTA Online is going to be, whenever that finally shows up. Put all together, this could be quite the space hog. Then again, what did you expect? The level of detail in this thing is off the charts. You don’t get a big, granular open world that reacts to you and to itself without taking up huge amounts of space. No one was expecting GTA 6 to be a small game; the fact that it’s seemingly not the biggest ever is, honestly, a relief. Of course, all of this could change on launch day. Make sure you’ve got space open and a good internet connection for that download, because it’ll be a doozy. 🕹️ Level up your inbox Don’t miss the latest reviews, news and tips.
